title: Open Montage is a free AI video studio for scripts #AItools #VideoProduction #OpenMontage
description:
Open Montage transforms Claude Code into a fully capable video production studio that operates entirely for free. This platform is described as the world’s first agentic video production system, allowing users to generate various types of videos—such as animated explainers, cinematic trailers, product advertisements, talking head segments, and podcast clips—simply by describing their needs in plain English. The system automates complex production stages including research, scripting, voiceover, visuals, and editing. The core advantage of Open Montage lies in its integration of 11 specialized production pipelines combined with 49 tools and over 400 agent skills. It enhances content relevance by conducting live web searches across platforms like YouTube, Reddit, and news sites before generating scripts, ensuring videos are based on up-to-date information. The platform’s effectiveness and cost efficiency are demonstrated through examples like creating a cinematic sci-fi trailer and a product ad for a minimal price, leveraging compatibility with Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot without requiring API keys. This solution meets the needs of creators and marketers seeking comprehensive, AI-driven video production without the typical barriers of software costs or technical complexity. Its accessibility and advanced automation have fueled its appeal, highlighting a significant productivity leap for content creators and businesses. #OpenMontage #AIVideoProduction #VideoCreation
